subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps - NovaHealth POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps - NovaHealth POC

Hi Jordan -

Thanks again for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum for the POC:

Pain points you shared:
- Inconsistent latency on inference pipelines during peak hours (~400-600ms p50, spikes to >1.5s).
- High per-token costs due to small batch sizes and repeated context re-sends.
- Compliance requirement: customer PHI must remain within the NovaHealth VPC for the POC.

Goals you described:
1) Validate sub-300ms p50 inference for typical 512-token prompts under estimated load (50 req/s).
2) Reduce per-token cost by 30% via smart batching and prefix caching.
3) Demonstrate a secure private deployment option that meets NovaHealth security checklist (VPC + KMS).

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (milestones, owners, dates):
- M1: Kickoff & access provisioning - NovaHealth: provide VPN/VPC peering details and sample dataset (PII-masked) - Owner: Jordan/Carlos - Due: 2026-07-13
- M2: Baseline run & metrics capture - Redwood: run baseline on hosted/dedicated variants, capture p50/p95 and cost profile - Owner: Rishi - Due: 2026-07-20
- M3: Private deployment & security review - Redwood + NovaHealth security - Owner: Stephanie + Asha - Due: 2026-07-27
- M4: Optimization pass (batching, quantization) - Redwood - Owner: Rishi - Due: 2026-08-03
- M5: Executive review & decision - NovaHealth execs - Owner: Jordan/Asha - Target: 2026-08-10

Stakeholders confirmed on call:
- NovaHealth: Jordan Lee (DS Lead), Carlos Mendez (Infra), Asha Patel (Security)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Rishi Malhotra (SRE/SE), Stephanie Nguyen (Customer Security)

Decision process / timeline:
- NovaHealth will run internal review of security artifacts and provide go/no-go for private deployment by M3 due date. Exec decision targeted for the week of 2026-08-10.

Open questions / risks:
- Will NovaHealth be able to provide a masked sample dataset by 2026-07-13?
- Are there any custom onboarding windows for the VPC peering team that could push M1?

Attachments: I've attached a draft MAP (NovaHealth-MAP-v1.2.xlsx) and a reference network diagram.

Next steps (my ask):
1) Jordan/Carlos - confirm access timeline and point person for VPC peering by Monday 2026-07-12.
2) Rishi/Redwood - we will schedule the baseline run once we have test data and access.
3) I'll send calendar invites for the M2 baseline run and the M3 security review.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 45-minute baseline session next week. Thanks - looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0194

Marissa - thanks for the clear summary and MAP. Confirming the following from our side:

- We can provide a masked sample dataset by 2026-07-13. Carlos will lead on packaging the dataset and will share S3 access details (read-only) to your infra team.
- VPC peering: our infra team is available to kick off the peering work next week; Carlos is the point of contact. Typical window is 3-5 business days once we exchange configuration.
- Security: Asha will review the draft MAP and provide any additional evidence items required for the security review by 2026-07-20.

We agree with the milestones and dates. Two small asks:
1) Can Rishi include an initial estimate of required GPU capacity for the baseline run so we can provision a test node if needed?
2) Please add a row for the POC acceptance criteria: definition of success (p50 < 300ms AND cost reduction >= 25% OR exec signoff).

I'll route this to our procurement team after the executive review if we move forward. Thanks - see you on the baseline session invite.

- Jordan
Jordan Lee

Quick technical note following up on the ask for GPU estimates:

- For a baseline 50 req/s with 512-token average and throughput target p50 < 300ms, estimate: 1x A100-40GB or 2x T4 equivalents for a short-run baseline. If you want headroom for load testing (burst to 150 req/s), recommend 2x A100 or equivalent.
- We'll instrument Prometheus metrics and provide a perf dashboard.
- For the private deployment, we'll prepare a checklist for KMS integration and an example Terraform snippet for peering.

I'll add these items into the MAP spreadsheet and re-upload. Rishi
